zh-CN.title: 旧头像平滑升级
items: 旧版SVG头像按原序号替换为新头像
序号超过36的头像按顺序循环映射
自定义上传头像不受本次升级影响

en.title: A seamless upgrade for legacy avatars
items: Legacy SVG avatars now map to the new collection by number
Avatar numbers above 36 wrap through the collection in order
Custom uploaded avatars are unaffected by this upgrade
